q: 我是昨天晚上发烧___。
zh: 我是昨天晚上发烧的。
py: wǒ shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng fā shāo de
en: I got a fever last night.
why: 是 already stresses 昨天晚上, so the verb phrase closes with 的. 了 would report the fever as news and cannot sit inside 是…的; 过 and 着 do not fit one dated event.

q: 这台电脑是在网上___的。
zh: 这台电脑是在网上买的。
py: zhè tái diàn nǎo shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
en: I bought this computer online.
why: The stressed detail is 在网上, so the bare verb 买 comes right before 的. 买了, 买过 and 买着 add aspect that cannot sit inside 是…的.

q: 妈妈是昨天下午___我去医院的。
zh: 妈妈是昨天下午带我去医院的。
py: mā ma shì zuó tiān xià wǔ dài wǒ qù yī yuàn de
en: Mum took me to the hospital yesterday afternoon.
why: The frame needs a verb meaning "take someone": 带我去医院. 被 and 把 are grammar words that cannot replace the verb, and 给我去 is not Chinese.

q: 我是用手机___的这个视频。
zh: 我是用手机拍的这个视频。
py: wǒ shì yòng shǒu jī pāi de zhè ge shì pín
en: I filmed this video with my phone.
why: Inside 是…的 the verb stays bare: 用手机拍的. Adding 了, 过 or 着 before 的 breaks the pattern.

q: 弟弟是___奶奶一起去医院的。
zh: 弟弟是跟奶奶一起去医院的。
py: dì di shì gēn nǎi nai yì qǐ qù yī yuàn de
en: My younger brother went to the hospital with Grandma.
why: 跟…一起 means "together with", which is the manner detail being stressed. 把 and 被 need a different sentence shape; 对 means "toward".

q: 他___上个星期感冒的，现在还没好。
zh: 他是上个星期感冒的，现在还没好。
py: tā shì shàng ge xīng qī gǎn mào de xiàn zài hái méi hǎo
en: He caught the cold last week, and he is still not better.
why: 是 goes right before the stressed time 上个星期. 在 would need a place, and 就 or 又 cannot stand in for 是 in front of a time phrase.

q: 我是一个人坐两个小时的火车来看病___，家人都不知道。
zh: 我是一个人坐两个小时的火车来看病的，家人都不知道。
py: wǒ shì yí ge rén zuò liǎng ge xiǎo shí de huǒ chē lái kàn bìng de jiā rén dōu bù zhī dao
en: I came to see a doctor alone, taking a two-hour train, and my family does not know.
why: Both the manner (一个人, 坐火车) and the event are known; 是 starts the stressed part and 的 closes it. 了 cannot sit inside 是…的, and 过 or 着 do not mark a past detail.

q: 我是去年夏天在医院认识我先生___，那时候我在那儿当护士。
zh: 我是去年夏天在医院认识我先生的，那时候我在那儿当护士。
py: wǒ shì qù nián xià tiān zài yī yuàn rèn shi wǒ xiān sheng de nà shí hou wǒ zài nà r dāng hù shì
en: I met my husband at the hospital last summer, when I was working there as a nurse.
why: The marriage is known, so only when and where are being given: 是去年夏天在医院…的. 了 would announce a new event, and 过 would mean "have ever met".

q: 这个手机___我哥哥买的。
zh: 这个手机是我哥哥买的。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì wǒ gē ge mǎi de
en: My older brother bought this phone.
why: To say who bought a finished thing, Chinese puts 是 before the doer. 被 gives the English passive shape, but 被我哥哥买的 is not how this is said.

q: 我今天是来看医生___。
zh: 我今天是来看医生的。
py: wǒ jīn tiān shì lái kàn yī shēng de
en: I came today to see the doctor.
why: 是 before 来 plus a purpose is closed by 的, which presents the visit as something already happened and understood. 了 would simply report the arrival and is out of place after 是.

q: 他___为了给奶奶看病才搬到上海的。
zh: 他是为了给奶奶看病才搬到上海的。
py: tā shì wèi le gěi nǎi nai kàn bìng cái bān dào shàng hǎi de
en: He moved to Shanghai only in order to get treatment for his grandmother.
why: 是 stands before the purpose phrase 为了…, and 的 closes it at the end. 不, 没 and 别 would negate or forbid, which clashes with the 的 ending.

q: 这张照片是谁用手机拍___？
zh: 这张照片是谁用手机拍的？
py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shì shuí yòng shǒu jī pāi de
en: Who took this photo with a phone?
why: The photo already exists and 谁 asks about the doer, so the question is 是谁…的. 了 would not fit 是, and 吗 cannot be added to a question that already has 谁.

q: 我不是来找医生的，我是来给朋友___东西的。
zh: 我不是来找医生的，我是来给朋友送东西的。
py: wǒ bú shì lái zhǎo yī shēng de wǒ shì lái gěi péng you sòng dōng xi de
en: I did not come to see the doctor; I came to bring something for a friend.
why: The purpose slot is 来 + verb phrase + 的, and that verb stays bare. 送了, 送过 and 送着 all add aspect that does not belong inside the purpose phrase.

q: 你是在哪儿看___病？
zh: 你是在哪儿看的病？
py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r kàn de bìng
en: Where did you see the doctor?
why: With a noun object, 的 may come right after the verb: 看的病. 了 and 着 do not belong inside 是…的, and 过 would ask about experience.

q: 他是上个月回___。
zh: 他是上个月回来的。
py: tā shì shàng ge yuè huí lái de
en: He came back last month.
why: 的 closes the whole verb 回来, so it goes after 来. Splitting the verb with 的 or adding 了 breaks the pattern.

q: 我是在网上买___这双鞋，不是在商店。
zh: 我是在网上买的这双鞋，不是在商店。
py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de zhè shuāng xié bú shì zài shāng diàn
en: I bought these shoes online, not in a shop.
why: 的 can sit right after the verb when a noun object follows: 买的这双鞋. 了 does not belong in 是…的.

q: 他是昨天在网上给我发___短信。
zh: 他是昨天在网上给我发的短信。
py: tā shì zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng gěi wǒ fā de duǎn xìn
en: It was yesterday, online, that he sent me the message.
why: 的 can follow the verb directly even with a noun object. 发了短信 inside a 是…的 frame is wrong, because the pattern already fixes the past.

q: 他是昨天夜里一个人从医院走回___的，没有坐车。
zh: 他是昨天夜里一个人从医院走回去的，没有坐车。
py: tā shì zuó tiān yè lǐ yí ge rén cóng yī yuàn zǒu huí qù de méi yǒu zuò chē
en: He walked back from the hospital alone last night and did not take a car.
why: 走回去 is one verb unit, and 的 comes after the whole thing. 的 cannot cut 回去 in two, and 了 or 着 cannot be wedged in either.

q: 你在哪儿买___？这个手机真好看。
zh: 你在哪儿买的？这个手机真好看。
py: nǐ zài nǎ r mǎi de zhè ge shǒu jī zhēn hǎo kàn
en: Where did you buy it? This phone looks great.
why: Without 是, the sentence still needs 的 to mark a known purchase and ask where. 吗 cannot be added to a 哪儿 question, and 过 would ask where you have bought it before.

q: 这___我昨天在网上买的，用了两次就坏了。
zh: 这是我昨天在网上买的，用了两次就坏了。
py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de yòng le liǎng cì jiù huài le
en: I bought this online yesterday, and it broke after two uses.
why: After 这 or 那 as the subject, 是 stays: 这是我昨天买的. 不, 没 and 都 make no sense in this slot.

q: 我的手机在网上买___，比商店便宜两百块。
zh: 我的手机在网上买的，比商店便宜两百块。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī zài wǎng shàng mǎi de bǐ shāng diàn pián yi liǎng bǎi kuài
en: I bought my phone online, and it was 200 yuan cheaper than in a shop.
why: 是 is dropped but 的 stays, giving 在网上买的 as the known detail. 吗 turns it into a question, and 过 or 着 do not fit a single past purchase.

q: 这个软件___我朋友推荐给我的，不是我自己找到的。
zh: 这个软件是我朋友推荐给我的，不是我自己找到的。
py: zhè ge ruǎn jiàn shì wǒ péng you tuī jiàn gěi wǒ de bú shì wǒ zì jǐ zhǎo dào de
en: This software was recommended to me by my friend; I did not find it myself.
why: 是 introduces the doer 我朋友 and is kept because 这个软件 is the subject. 没, 别 and 会 cannot take that slot.

q: 我___是坐飞机来的，我是坐火车来的。
zh: 我不是坐飞机来的，我是坐火车来的。
py: wǒ bú shì zuò fēi jī lái de wǒ shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
en: I did not come by plane; I came by train.
why: The negative of 是…的 is 不是…的. 没 and 没有 negate an action, not the stressed detail, and 是 cannot be dropped here.

q: 这部手机___是我买___，是我姐姐买的。
zh: 这部手机不是我买的，是我姐姐买的。
py: zhè bù shǒu jī bú shì wǒ mǎi de shì wǒ jiě jie mǎi de
en: I did not buy this phone; my older sister did.
why: The doer is being denied, so the frame is 不是…的. 没 is not used with 是, and 了 does not belong in the pattern.

q: 我不是在医院出生___，是在家里。
zh: 我不是在医院出生的，是在家里。
py: wǒ bú shì zài yī yuàn chū shēng de shì zài jiā lǐ
en: I was not born in a hospital; I was born at home.
why: Even in the negative, 的 stays at the end of 不是…的. 了 would turn the sentence into plain news and 过 or 着 do not fit.

q: 他___是昨天晚上头疼的，已经疼了三天了。
zh: 他不是昨天晚上头疼的，已经疼了三天了。
py: tā bú shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng tóu téng de yǐ jīng téng le sān tiān le
en: His headache did not start last night; it has hurt for three days.
why: The detail 昨天晚上 is wrong, not the headache itself, so the negative is 不是…的. 没 and 没有 would not pair with 是.

q: 这个视频不___我在网上下载的，是我朋友发给我的。
zh: 这个视频不是我在网上下载的，是我朋友发给我的。
py: zhè ge shì pín bú shì wǒ zài wǎng shàng xià zài de shì wǒ péng you fā gěi wǒ de
en: I did not download this video online; my friend sent it to me.
why: 不是 + doer/place + verb + 的 denies the detail. 不会, 不要 and 不能 are modals and would lose the past-event meaning.

q: 我昨天买___一个新手机。
zh: 我昨天买了一个新手机。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yí ge xīn shǒu jī
en: I bought a new phone yesterday.
why: A new event with a counted object is news, so 了 follows the verb. 的 cannot do that, and 买的一个新手机 is only a fragment.

q: 我的手机坏了，是我昨天在地铁上摔___。
zh: 我的手机坏了，是我昨天在地铁上摔的。
py: wǒ de shǒu jī huài le shì wǒ zuó tiān zài dì tiě shàng shuāi de
en: My phone is broken; I dropped it on the subway yesterday.
why: The breaking is known; the clause only explains when and where, so 是…的. 了 would repeat news and cannot follow 是.

q: 医生，我昨天头疼___，今天又发烧了。
zh: 医生，我昨天头疼了，今天又发烧了。
py: yī shēng wǒ zuó tiān tóu téng le jīn tiān yòu fā shāo le
en: Doctor, I had a headache yesterday and today I have a fever again.
why: The patient is telling the doctor something new, so 了 reports it. 的 would need a known event and a stressed detail, and 吗 makes no sense in a statement.

q: 这台电脑很新，___上个星期买的。
zh: 这台电脑很新，是上个星期买的。
py: zhè tái diàn nǎo hěn xīn shì shàng ge xīng qī mǎi de
en: This computer is very new; I bought it last week.
why: The computer is in front of both speakers, so only the time is new: 是上个星期买的. 了 and 过 cannot replace 是.

q: 我昨天在网上买___一台电脑，是朋友推荐的牌子。
zh: 我昨天在网上买了一台电脑，是朋友推荐的牌子。
py: wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi le yī tái diàn nǎo shì péng you tuī jiàn de pái zi
en: I bought a computer online yesterday; it is a brand a friend recommended.
why: A counted object (一台电脑) makes this a report, so 了 follows 买. 的 would ask for a known event with a stressed detail.

q: 我听说他昨天去了医院，不知道他是怎么去___。
zh: 我听说他昨天去了医院，不知道他是怎么去的。
py: wǒ tīng shuō tā zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn bù zhī dao tā shì zěn me qù de
en: I heard he went to the hospital yesterday; I do not know how he got there.
why: His trip is known; only the how is unknown, so 是怎么去的. 了 cannot follow 是怎么 in this clause.

q: 你是怎么来___？
zh: 你是怎么来的？
py: nǐ shì zěn me lái de
en: How did you get here?
why: You are already here, so you ask the way you came: 是怎么来的. 了 would not combine with 是…怎么, and 吗 cannot be added to a question word.

q: 你是什么时候开始头疼___？
zh: 你是什么时候开始头疼的？
py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou kāi shǐ tóu téng de
en: When did your headache start?
why: The headache is known, and 什么时候 asks about its start. 是…的 is the frame. 吗 cannot join a 什么时候 question.

q: 你是坐地铁来的___？
zh: 你是坐地铁来的吗？
py: nǐ shì zuò dì tiě lái de ma
en: Did you come by subway?
why: Add 吗 after 的 to make a yes/no question. 什么, 哪儿 and 谁 are question words, which cannot be used in addition to a stated manner.

q: 你___坐地铁来的？
zh: 你是不是坐地铁来的？
py: nǐ shì bú shì zuò dì tiě lái de
en: Did you come by subway?
why: 是不是 sits right before the stressed detail and turns the sentence into an A-not-A question. 是吗 and 不是吗 need to stand alone, and 有没有 asks about 有.

q: 这封电子邮件是谁给你___？
zh: 这封电子邮件是谁给你发的？
py: zhè fēng diàn zi yóu jiàn shì shuí gěi nǐ fā de
en: Who sent you this email?
why: The email exists, so you ask for the sender: 是谁给你发的. 发了, 发过 and 发着 add aspect inside a 是…的 question.

q: 我明天___坐地铁去医院。
zh: 我明天要坐地铁去医院。
py: wǒ míng tiān yào zuò dì tiě qù yī yuàn
en: I am going to the hospital by subway tomorrow.
why: 明天 marks the future, so the sentence uses plain word order with 要 and no 是…的. 的, 了 and 过 all refer to what has already happened.

q: 我下个星期六___坐火车去上海，不坐飞机。
zh: 我下个星期六要坐火车去上海，不坐飞机。
py: wǒ xià ge xīng qī liù yào zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi bù zuò fēi jī
en: Next Saturday I will go to Shanghai by train, not by plane.
why: The trip has not happened, so 要 plus plain order is right. 把, 被 and 过 do not fit a plan.

q: 医生说我明天___去检查身体，所以今天晚上不能吃东西。
zh: 医生说我明天要去检查身体，所以今天晚上不能吃东西。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ míng tiān yào qù jiǎn chá shēn tǐ suǒ yǐ jīn tiān wǎn shàng bù néng chī dōng xi
en: The doctor said I have to go for a check-up tomorrow, so I cannot eat tonight.
why: 明天 sets a future reference and 所以不能吃 confirms it. 要 states the plan; 了, 过 and 着 are aspect markers for what is already done.

zh: 我昨天感冒的。
py: wǒ zuó tiān gǎn mào de
en: I caught a cold yesterday.
why: 是 is dropped in speech, but 的 stays at the end. The time word may come before or after 我.

zh: 她是坐出租车来的。
py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē lái de
en: She came by taxi.
why: 是 stands right before the stressed manner 坐出租车, and 的 comes after the verb 来. 是 cannot follow 来.

zh: 这张照片是用手机拍的。
py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shì yòng shǒu jī pāi de
en: This photo was taken with a phone.
why: 是 goes before the manner phrase 用手机, and 的 closes after 拍. The phrase cannot follow the verb.

zh: 我们是在网上认识的。
py: wǒ men shì zài wǎng shàng rèn shi de
en: We met online.
why: 是 comes before the place 在网上, and 的 follows 认识. 在网上 cannot go after the verb here.

zh: 他是上个星期从医院回来的。
py: tā shì shàng ge xīng qī cóng yī yuàn huí lái de
en: He came back from the hospital last week.
why: 是 stands before the time 上个星期, then the 从 phrase, then the verb 回来, with 的 at the very end. 的 cannot split 回来.

zh: 我是在网上买的手机。
py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de shǒu jī
en: I bought the phone online.
why: 的 may come right after the verb or at the end. The object can also be the topic at the front. 的 cannot go before 买.

zh: 她是上个星期回来的。
py: tā shì shàng ge xīng qī huí lái de
en: She came back last week.
why: 的 closes the verb 回来; it cannot be placed inside it. 是 comes before the time 上个月.

zh: 你是怎么回家的？
py: nǐ shì zěn me huí jiā de
en: How did you get home?
why: The question word 怎么 takes the stressed slot after 是, and 的 ends the sentence. 怎么 cannot follow the verb.

zh: 你是什么时候开始咳嗽的？
py: nǐ shì shén me shí hou kāi shǐ ké sòu de
en: When did your cough start?
why: The question word 什么时候 goes between 是 and the verb phrase. 的 closes the sentence.

zh: 这个号码是谁告诉你的？
py: zhè ge hào mǎ shì shuí gào su nǐ de
en: Who gave you this number?
why: 是 comes before the question word 谁, and 的 ends the sentence. 号码 must come first as the topic.

zh: 这台电脑是你在网上买的吗？
py: zhè tái diàn nǎo shì nǐ zài wǎng shàng mǎi de ma
en: Did you buy this computer online?
why: 是 comes before the doer 你, then the 在 phrase, then the verb and 的. 吗 ends the yes/no question.

zh: 我不是在家里出生的。
py: wǒ bú shì zài jiā lǐ chū shēng de
en: I was not born at home.
why: 不是 replaces 是 and stays before the denied detail. 没 is not used, and 不 cannot go before 出生 here.

zh: 这个视频不是我拍的。
py: zhè ge shì pín bú shì wǒ pāi de
en: I did not shoot this video.
why: 不是 + doer + verb + 的. The negation attaches to 是, not to the verb 拍.

zh: 他不是坐飞机来的是坐火车来的。
py: tā bú shì zuò fēi jī lái de shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
en: He did not come by plane; he came by train.
why: The denied detail takes 不是 and the true detail takes 是, each closed by 的. The two halves may be swapped.

zh: 这个菜是我妈妈做的。
py: zhè ge cài shì wǒ mā ma zuò de
en: My mum made this dish.
why: 是 stands before the doer 我妈妈, and 的 comes after 做. 被 is not used for "made by".

zh: 这个药是医生给我的。
py: zhè ge yào shì yī shēng gěi wǒ de
en: The doctor gave me this medicine.
why: 是 comes before the doer 医生; 的 is last. 药 comes first as the thing that is already known.

zh: 我是来看医生的。
py: wǒ shì lái kàn yī shēng de
en: I came to see the doctor.
why: 是 before 来 stresses purpose, and 的 ends the sentence. 是 does not follow 来.

zh: 他是为了看病搬到北京的。
py: tā shì wèi le kàn bìng bān dào běi jīng de
en: He moved to Beijing to get medical treatment.
why: 是 stands before the purpose phrase 为了看病, then the verb phrase 搬到北京, then 的. 为了 cannot follow 搬到.

zh: 我昨天买了一台新电脑。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī tái xīn diàn nǎo
en: I bought a new computer yesterday.
why: A new event with a counted object takes 了 after the verb and no 是…的. The time word may come before or after 我.

zh: 他打算明年坐火车去上海。
py: tā dǎ suàn míng nián zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi
en: He plans to go to Shanghai by train next year.
why: The trip is in the future, so the order is plain: time, manner, verb. No 是…的 is used.

src_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù yī yuàn le
task: Say it was yesterday that I went to the hospital (the trip is known). Use 是…的.
zh: 我是昨天去医院的。
py: wǒ shì zuó tiān qù yī yuàn de
en: I went to the hospital yesterday.
why: Once the trip is known, 是 goes before the time 昨天 and 的 closes the verb phrase. 的 may also come right after 去.

src_py: tā zuò chū zū chē lái le
task: Stress how he came with 是…的.
zh: 他是坐出租车来的。
py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē lái de
en: He came by taxi.
why: The coming is known, so 是 goes before the manner 坐出租车 and 的 after 来. 了 is removed.

src_py: mā ma mǎi le zhè ge shǒu jī
task: Stress who bought it with 是…的. Start with 这个手机.
zh: 这个手机是妈妈买的。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì mā ma mǎi de
en: Mum bought this phone.
why: The phone is known, so 是 goes before the doer. 被 is not used for "bought by".

src_py: wǒ shì zuò dì tiě lái de
task: Make it negative.
zh: 我不是坐地铁来的。
py: wǒ bú shì zuò dì tiě lái de
en: I did not come by subway.
why: 不是 goes before the denied detail, and 的 stays. 没 is never used with 是…的.

src_py: zhè zhāng zhào piān shì wǒ pāi de
task: Make it negative.
zh: 这张照片不是我拍的。
py: zhè zhāng zhào piān bú shì wǒ pāi de
en: I did not take this photo.
why: 不是 replaces 是 in front of the doer and 的 stays. 没 cannot be used here.

src_py: nǐ shì zěn me lái de
task: Drop 是.
zh: 你怎么来的？
py: nǐ zěn me lái de
en: How did you get here?
why: 是 is optional in questions, but 的 must stay or the question breaks.

src_py: tā shì zuó tiān dào de
task: Ask when he arrived.
zh: 他是什么时候到的？
py: tā shì shén me shí hou dào de
en: When did he arrive?
why: The question word replaces 昨天 in the stressed slot after 是. 吗 is not added.

src_py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē qù de
task: Turn it into a yes/no question with 吗.
zh: 她是坐出租车去的吗？
py: tā shì zuò chū zū chē qù de ma
en: Did she go by taxi?
why: 吗 goes after 的 to ask a yes/no question without changing the rest of the pattern.

src_py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de shǒu jī
task: Move 的 to the end of the sentence.
zh: 我是在网上买手机的。
py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi shǒu jī de
en: I bought the phone online.
why: With a noun object 的 may sit right after the verb or at the end. The object may also move to the front as a topic.

src_py: tā shì shàng ge yuè huí lái de
task: Drop 是.
zh: 他上个月回来的。
py: tā shàng ge yuè huí lái de
en: He came back last month.
why: 是 can be dropped in affirmative statements, but 的 cannot. The time word may come before or after 他.

src_py: mā ma zuó tiān lái le
task: Say it was yesterday that she came (her visit is known). Use 是…的.
zh: 妈妈是昨天来的。
py: mā ma shì zuó tiān lái de
en: Mum came yesterday.
why: Since her visit is known, the time is the point: 是昨天…的 with no 了.

src_py: tā qù shàng hǎi le
task: Say he went by train (his trip is known). Use 是…的.
zh: 他是坐火车去上海的。
py: tā shì zuò huǒ chē qù shàng hǎi de
en: He went to Shanghai by train.
why: The trip is known, so 是 goes before the manner phrase and 的 closes the verb phrase. 了 is dropped.

src_py: wǒ shì zuó tiān zuò huǒ chē qù de
task: Say you are going by train tomorrow instead.
zh: 我明天坐火车去。
py: wǒ míng tiān zuò huǒ chē qù
en: I am going by train tomorrow.
why: The trip has not happened, so 是…的 is dropped and the order stays plain.

src: 他是上个月搬到北京的。
src_py: tā shì shàng ge yuè bān dào běi jīng de
task: Say he plans to move next month.
zh: 他打算下个月搬到北京。
py: tā dǎ suàn xià ge yuè bān dào běi jīng
en: He plans to move to Beijing next month.
why: A plan is not a known past event, so 是…的 is replaced by 打算 and plain word order.

src_py: péng you sòng gěi wǒ zhè ge shǒu jī
task: Stress who gave it with 是…的. Start with 这个手机.
zh: 这个手机是朋友送给我的。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì péng you sòng gěi wǒ de
en: A friend gave me this phone.
why: The phone is known, so the doer is stressed with 是…的. 被 is not used for "given by".

src: 他搬到上海是因为工作。
src_py: tā bān dào shàng hǎi shì yīn wèi gōng zuò
task: Rewrite with 是为了…的.
zh: 他是为了工作搬到上海的。
py: tā shì wèi le gōng zuò bān dào shàng hǎi de
en: He moved to Shanghai for work.
why: Purpose goes in the stressed slot after 是 as 为了…, then the verb, then 的. 因为 is not used in this frame.

src_py: tā shì zuó tiān fā shāo de
task: Deny it: it was not yesterday.
zh: 他不是昨天发烧的。
py: tā bú shì zuó tiān fā shāo de
en: He did not get the fever yesterday.
why: 不是 goes before the denied time. 没发烧 would deny the fever itself, not the detail.

src_py: tā men shì zài wǎng shàng rèn shi de
task: Ask where they met.
zh: 他们是在哪儿认识的？
py: tā men shì zài nǎ r rèn shi de
en: Where did they meet?
why: The question word 在哪儿 takes the stressed slot and 的 stays at the end.

src_py: wǒ men shì shàng ge xīng qī dào de
task: Drop 是.
zh: 我们上个星期到的。
py: wǒ men shàng ge xīng qī dào de
en: We arrived last week.
why: 是 can disappear in a plain statement, but 的 must stay.

src_py: wǎn fàn shì mā ma zuò de
task: Ask who made dinner.
zh: 晚饭是谁做的？
py: wǎn fàn shì shuí zuò de
en: Who made dinner?
why: 谁 replaces the doer after 是 and 的 stays at the end. 吗 is not added.

s: 我是昨天发烧了的。
s_py: wǒ shì zuó tiān fā shāo le de
zh: 我是昨天发烧的。
py: wǒ shì zuó tiān fā shāo de
en: I got a fever yesterday.
why: 了 never goes inside 是…的; the frame already places the event in the past.

s: 这个手机没是我买的。
s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī méi shì wǒ mǎi de
zh: 这个手机不是我买的。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī bú shì wǒ mǎi de
en: I did not buy this phone.
why: 是 is always negated with 不. 没是 does not exist, in 是…的 or anywhere else.

s: 这个手机被我爸爸买的。
s_py: zhè ge shǒu jī bèi wǒ bà ba mǎi de
zh: 这个手机是我爸爸买的。
py: zhè ge shǒu jī shì wǒ bà ba mǎi de
en: My dad bought this phone.
why: Telling who did something takes 是 + doer + verb + 的, not 被. 被 and a final 的 also never go together here.

s: 奶奶是昨天晚上回的来。
s_py: nǎi nai shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng huí de lái
zh: 奶奶是昨天晚上回来的。
py: nǎi nai shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng huí lái de
en: Grandma came back last night.
why: 的 cannot split 回来. It goes after the whole verb.

s: 你是怎么去的吗？
s_py: nǐ shì zěn me qù de ma
zh: 你是怎么去的？
py: nǐ shì zěn me qù de
en: How did you get there?
why: A question already containing a question word never takes 吗.

s: 我是明天坐地铁去的。
s_py: wǒ shì míng tiān zuò dì tiě qù de
zh: 我明天坐地铁去。
py: wǒ míng tiān zuò dì tiě qù
en: I am going by subway tomorrow.
why: 明天 places the trip in the future, and 是…的 is only used for events that have already happened.

s: 我是在网上的买这个手机。
s_py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng de mǎi zhè ge shǒu jī
zh: 我是在网上买的这个手机。
py: wǒ shì zài wǎng shàng mǎi de zhè ge shǒu jī
en: I bought this phone online.
why: 的 is only used after the verb or at the end of the sentence, never before the verb.

s: 我不是昨天来了的。
s_py: wǒ bú shì zuó tiān lái le de
zh: 我不是昨天来的。
py: wǒ bú shì zuó tiān lái de
en: I did not come yesterday.
why: 了 does not belong inside 不是…的, just as it does not belong inside 是…的.

s: 这条短信我朋友是发的。
s_py: zhè tiáo duǎn xìn wǒ péng you shì fā de
zh: 这条短信是我朋友发的。
py: zhè tiáo duǎn xìn shì wǒ péng you fā de
en: My friend sent this text message.
why: 是 comes before the doer, not after it.

s: 他昨天是到的。
s_py: tā zuó tiān shì dào de
zh: 他是昨天到的。
py: tā shì zuó tiān dào de
en: He arrived yesterday.
why: 是 goes right before the stressed detail 昨天, not before the verb.

s: 我坐地铁来的。
s_py: wǒ zuò dì tiě lái de
zh: 我坐地铁来的。
py: wǒ zuò dì tiě lái de
en: I came by subway.
why: 是 may be dropped in a plain statement, as here. 的 stays at the end.

s: 这是我昨天在网上买的。
s_py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
zh: 这是我昨天在网上买的。
py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān zài wǎng shàng mǎi de
en: I bought this online yesterday.
why: After 这 as the subject the 是 is part of the sentence, and 的 closes the detail 我昨天在网上买.

s: 我昨天看见他的。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn jiàn tā de
zh: 我昨天看见他的。
py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn jiàn tā de
en: I saw him yesterday.
why: 的 can go at the very end even when the object is a pronoun. The final 的 is the standard choice.

s: 你是在哪儿买的手机？
s_py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r mǎi de shǒu jī
zh: 你是在哪儿买的手机？
py: nǐ shì zài nǎ r mǎi de shǒu jī
en: Where did you buy your phone?
why: 的 can come right after the verb even with a noun object that follows.

s: 这个字我是用手机查的。
s_py: zhè ge zì wǒ shì yòng shǒu jī chá de
zh: 这个字我是用手机查的。
py: zhè ge zì wǒ shì yòng shǒu jī chá de
en: I looked this character up on my phone.
why: The object may be fronted as a topic, then 是…的 follows as usual.

s: 他去上海了，是坐火车去的。
s_py: tā qù shàng hǎi le shì zuò huǒ chē qù de
zh: 他去上海了，是坐火车去的。
py: tā qù shàng hǎi le shì zuò huǒ chē qù de
en: He has gone to Shanghai; he went by train.
why: The first clause reports the trip with 了, and the second gives a detail of that trip with 是…的.

s: 我没坐飞机来，我是坐火车来的。
s_py: wǒ méi zuò fēi jī lái wǒ shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
zh: 我没坐飞机来，我是坐火车来的。
py: wǒ méi zuò fēi jī lái wǒ shì zuò huǒ chē lái de
en: I did not come by plane; I came by train.
why: 没 without 的 simply denies the plane trip; then 是…的 states the true manner.

s: 医生说他不是昨天才发烧的，已经发烧三天了。
s_py: yī shēng shuō tā bú shì zuó tiān cái fā shāo de yǐ jīng fā shāo sān tiān le
zh: 医生说他不是昨天才发烧的，已经发烧三天了。
py: yī shēng shuō tā bú shì zuó tiān cái fā shāo de yǐ jīng fā shāo sān tiān le
en: The doctor said his fever did not start only yesterday; he has had it for three days.
why: 不是…的 denies the detail 昨天才, and the second clause gives the real duration.

s: 我是为了陪奶奶看病才来这个城市的。
s_py: wǒ shì wèi le péi nǎi nai kàn bìng cái lái zhè ge chéng shì de
zh: 我是为了陪奶奶看病才来这个城市的。
py: wǒ shì wèi le péi nǎi nai kàn bìng cái lái zhè ge chéng shì de
en: I came to this city only to go with Grandma to see the doctor.
why: The purpose phrase 为了… stays between 是 and the verb, and 才 can sit before the verb.

s: 我昨天去了医院。
s_py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn
zh: 我昨天去了医院。
py: wǒ zuó tiān qù le yī yuàn
en: I went to the hospital yesterday.
why: This reports a new event with 了; it is correct even though 昨天 is present.
